_comment: DYST global settings. Every value here can be overridden per media file with a same-named sidecar (.json/.txt next to the media). Key order groups: Core loop -> Media & playback -> Audio -> Display & layout -> Chroma key -> System; related keys stay adjacent. Every key is explained in the _hints block at the bottom, including how it interacts with the per-file sidecar keys (see config_template.json for the per-file reference). Bad values are ignored with a warning, never crash the app.

_hints.tick_seconds: Seconds between chance rolls. Each tick rolls 1-in-`odds`. Must be > 0. Interacts with `odds` (how often a tick CAN hit) and `max_concurrent` (how many plays one tick may burst). Default 1.0.
_hints.odds: 1-in-N chance per tick (1000 = 0.1% every tick). Lower = more frequent. Must be >= 1. Interacts with `tick_seconds` (overall frequency) and `max_concurrent` (burst cap). Default 1000.
_hints.max_concurrent: Maximum overlays allowed on screen at once; 0 = unlimited. Also caps the same-tick re-roll burst. Counts only currently-playing overlays. Default 3. (This is the single concurrency key; the old `max_on_screen` was a duplicate and was removed.)
_hints.play_once: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. true = all media cannot be selected again while any copy of it is already playing. false = repeats are allowed. Overrides the global `play_once`. Default false. Strict true/false value (no randomization).
_hints.reroll_in_same_tick: Reserved for forward-compat: on a success the ticker ALWAYS re-rolls in the same tick (burst) up to `max_concurrent`. v1 is locked to true; changing this value currently has no effect. Default true. Strict true/false value (no randomization).
_hints.media_folder: Media root scanned for content. Relative paths resolve from the app folder (absolute allowed). `media/images/` and `media/videos/` are scanned; each file's sidecar audio + per-file settings live in the same subfolder. Default 'media'.
_hints.download_max_height: Only used by scripts/download_videos.py: maximum video height (px) to download. The CLI's 3rd argument overrides this. Default 1080.
_hints.rescan_seconds: While the daemon runs, re-scan `media_folder` every N seconds so newly added/removed files are picked up. 0 = scan once at startup only. Default 60.
_hints.image_display_seconds: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. How long image/animation stays up (seconds). Overrides the global `image_display_seconds` and takes PRIORITY over the per-file `duration` alias when both are present. Ignored by videos (they run to their end unless `max_duration` caps them). Supports randomization: a "min~max" string (e.g. "0.5~1.5") draws a new value every trigger; both bounds must be valid.
_hints.end_on_audio_end: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. IMAGES/GIFs only: true = image IGNORES its display time and stays up until its sidecar audio ENDS, then fades out. No sidecar audio = no effect (normal timer runs). Overrides the global `end_on_audio_end`. `max_duration` still applies and wins over a long audio track. Strict true/false value (no randomization).
_hints.fade_in_seconds: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Fade-in (seconds) for image/GIF before the display clock starts: opacity 0 -> `opacity`. Videos ignore it. Overrides the global `fade_in_seconds`. Lifetime = fade_in + display + fade_out. `speed` divides all three. Supports randomization: a "min~max" string (e.g. "0.5~1.5") draws a new value every trigger; both bounds must be valid.
_hints.fade_out_seconds: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Fade-out (seconds) for image/GIF. Videos end instantly (no fade). Overrides the global `fade_out_seconds`. The old name `fade_seconds` is still accepted as a deprecated alias. 0 = instant. Supports randomization: a "min~max" string (e.g. "0.5~1.5") draws a new value every trigger; both bounds must be valid.
_hints.max_duration: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Hard cap (seconds) for all media AND its audio. When it fires, the visual + audio stop immediately, with NO fade-out, and the overlay closes. Overrides the global `max_duration`; a per-file 0 explicitly DISABLES a global cap for this file. 0 = no cap. Supports ranges: "1.0~5.0".
_hints.speed: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Playback speed multiplier for all media (> 0): scales video frame rate + own audio, GIF animation, sidecar audio, and image display time + fades (all timings / speed). Overrides the global `speed`, but is OVERRIDDEN by `speed_pitch` when that is > 0 (per-file > global). Default 1. Supports ranges: "1.0~2.0".
_hints.pitch: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Audio pitch multiplier for all media (> 0), independent of speed (the audio is re-encoded via ffmpeg; needs ffmpeg when != 1). Overrides the global `pitch`, but is OVERRIDDEN by `speed_pitch` when that is > 0. Default 1. Supports ranges: "0.5~1.5".
_hints.speed_pitch: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Combined speed+pitch for all media (>= 0): when > 0 it sets BOTH `speed` and `pitch` to this value and OVERRIDES the individual `speed`/`pitch` keys (per-file AND global). 0 = off (use speed/pitch separately). Per-file value wins over the global `speed_pitch`. Default 0. Supports ranges: "1.0~2.0".
_hints.max_playback_height: Playback resolution cap (px): videos + GIFs taller than this are downscaled (aspect kept) BEFORE decoding/chroma-keying/copying/painting, keeping playback stable on high-res clips. Still images ignore it. 0 = no cap (native resolution). Per-file sidecars override it. Changing it rebuilds the video precache.
_hints.max_playback_fps: Playback framerate cap: video frames above this are sampled (duration and audio untouched). 0 = no cap (native framerate). Per-file sidecars override it. Changing it rebuilds the video precache.
_hints.volume: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Volume multiplier for all media (0.0-5.0). MULTIPLIES the global `volume`: final = global * per-file, so 0.5 halves it and 2 doubles it (per-file does NOT replace global). Ignored when the file has no audio. Default 1. Supports randomization: a "min~max" string (e.g. "0.5~1.5") draws a new value every trigger; both bounds must be valid.
_hints.monitor: Which screen overlays appear on: 'primary' or 'all' (= pick a random monitor for EACH overlay, spreading them across your screens) or a 0-based monitor index. Default 'primary'. Not randomizable.
_hints.mode: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. How all media covers the screen: fit (default, whole media visible, aspect kept) | stretch (squish to screen) | cover-height (fit screen width, crop top/bottom) | cover-width (fit screen height, crop left/right) | custom (use the custom-mode keys below). Overrides the global `mode`. The removed 'cover' value falls back to 'fit'. Not randomizable.
_hints.opacity: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Overlay transparency for all media (0.0-1.0; 1 = fully opaque). Overrides the global `opacity`. Fades compose on top (fade-in 0 -> opacity, fade-out opacity -> 0). Supports randomization: a "min~max" string (e.g. "0.5~1.5") draws a new value every trigger; both bounds must be valid.
_hints.position_x: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Custom mode only: horizontal placement for all media, clamped to -1..2 (0 = left edge at the screen's left edge, 1 = right edge at the right edge, 0.5 = centered; outside 0..1 peeks/crops off-screen). Overrides the global `position_x`. Ignored unless `mode` is custom. Supports ranges: "-0.5~1.5".
_hints.position_y: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Custom mode only: vertical placement for all media, clamped to -1..2 (0 = top edge at the screen's top edge, 1 = bottom edge at the bottom edge, 0.5 = centered; outside 0..1 peeks/crops off-screen). Overrides the global `position_y`. Ignored unless `mode` is custom. Supports ranges: "-0.5~1.5".
_hints.scale_x: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Custom mode only: width multiplier for all media relative to the aspect-preserving 'fit' size (1 = whole media visible). Overrides the global `scale_x`. IMPORTANT: giving BOTH per-file `scale_x` AND `scale_y` OVERWRITES the per-file `scale`; a lone `scale_x`/`scale_y` overrides only its own axis. Ignored unless `mode` is custom. Supports ranges: "0.5~1.5".
_hints.scale_y: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Custom mode only: height multiplier for all media relative to the 'fit' size. Overrides the global `scale_y`. See `scale_x` for how it interacts with `scale` / `scale_x`. Ignored unless `mode` is custom. Supports ranges: "0.5~1.5".
_hints.flip_h: Custom mode only (when `mode` is 'custom'). Mirror every media horizontally. true/false, or the string "random" to pick a random bool on every spawn. Per-file value overrides this. Default false.
_hints.flip_v: Custom mode only (when `mode` is 'custom'). Mirror every media vertically. true/false, or the string "random" to pick a random bool on every spawn. Per-file value overrides this. Default false.
_hints.rotation: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Custom mode only: rotation in degrees for all media, around its own center (any number). Overrides the global `rotation`. Ignored unless `mode` is custom. Supports ranges: "0~360".
_hints.chroma_key: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Per-file chroma PRESET for all files: 'green' | 'blue' | 'weak green' | 'strong green' | 'weak blue' | 'strong blue' | 'black' | 'white' | 'custom'. Uses its own key independent of the global `chroma_key`. NOTE: setting a per-file preset turns keying ON for that file (it sets enabled = true), so only add it to files that really are shot against that colour screen; a per-file `chroma: false` still wins and skips keying. The precache key includes the preset, so changing it rebuilds the cache. Omitted from the top-level keys above so copying this template does not force keying on; see _example_sidecar. 'custom' ignores the presets: it takes the hue/saturation/value ranges from the per-file `chroma_hue_range` / `chroma_saturation_range` / `chroma_value_range` keys below instead. Not randomizable.
_hints.autostart: true = register this app in the Windows login Run key on every launch (silent start at login). false = a boot launch (Run key + --autostart flag) removes the key and exits; a manual launch clears any stale key and keeps running. Default false. Strict true/false value (no randomization).
_hints.show_console: true = keep a visible log terminal; false = hidden background. On the frozen exe the console is detached after config load (logs still go to app.log). Default false. Strict true/false value (no randomization).
_hints.debug: Verbose logging to app.log (and to the console when it is shown). Default false. Strict true/false value (no randomization).
_hints.kill_hotkey: Global keyboard shortcut that force-terminates the app (Windows only). Format 'ctrl+shift+alt+k' (modifiers + key joined by '+'; modifiers ctrl/shift/alt/win; key a-z, 0-9, f1-f12). Empty string = disabled. Dead man's switch for when overlays go haywire. Default 'ctrl+shift+alt+k'.
_hints.kill_notify: true = show a Windows notification when the kill switch fires, so the user knows why the app vanished (the balloon is drawn by a detached helper process and outlives the app). false = quit silently. Only relevant when `kill_hotkey` is set. Default true. Strict true/false value (no randomization).
_hints.chroma_hue_range: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Per-file custom-chroma range [lo, hi] — OpenCV hue 0..179 (green ~60, blue ~120). Used ONLY when `chroma_key` is 'custom' (or the expert dict form uses preset 'custom'); ignored for every other preset. Default [35, 85].
_hints.chroma_saturation_range: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Per-file custom-chroma range [lo, hi], saturation 0..255. Used ONLY when `chroma_key` is 'custom'; ignored otherwise. Default [40, 255].
_hints.chroma_value_range: Global default for every spawn; a per-file sidecar overrides it. Per-file custom-chroma range [lo, hi], value 0..255. Used ONLY when `chroma_key` is 'custom'; ignored otherwise. Default [40, 255].
